runtime_change: CUDAExecutionProvider now sets use_tf32=False; CPU remains the quality-profile default.
notes: Serial benchmark processes; no simultaneous inference benchmarks.
Current v1 user ONNX only; previous v0.x TensorRT performance is not substituted.
All gates, ROI fallback, auto rotation, tracking, quality and hybrid selection enabled; min_level=high.
Full videos, no early termination; source PTS pacing; capacity-one production worker.
Pooled quantiles recomputed from per-frame traces, never averages of run percentiles.
Capture-to-result excludes camera/driver/UI/network/Re-ID; includes worker queue.
Model inference includes transfer to/from GPU, excludes image preprocessing and postprocessing.
Cold measurements are session construction and first detect in an existing Python process; disk cache was not flushed.
RSS includes the benchmark sampler and profiling sessions; not deployment-only RAM use.
CPU package 1.23.2 is the delivered environment; 1.26.0 has its own matched CPU/CUDA controls.
Micro stage and replay stage are separate; do not infer replay FPS from 1000/P50.
Two recordings on one desktop do not establish performance on phones or held-out pose accuracy.
